**Daily Devotional**

**June 1**

*4 In whom the god of this world hath blinded the minds of them which believe not, lest the light of the glorious gospel of Christ, who is the image of God, should shine unto them. (2 Corinthians 4:4 KJV)*

In the New Testament one of the ways that Satan is referred to is “god of this world” (this verse), and “an angel of light” (2 Corinthians 11:14). Notice that one of the ways that Satan comes against us, is to blind the mind of the unbelievers. Satan also uses other means to come against mankind, such as deception and craftiness, disguising himself, temptation, condemnation, snaring, lying and stealing God’s word from us (Matthew 13:19). Satan is the father of all lies (John 8:44), and he will try to deceive us in any way he can. Satan has been really good at deceiving the church by distorting the Word of God, thereby making it mislead the majority of Christians.

When a person has the light of the Gospel of Christ shine unto them, and Satan doesn’t distort it and change it, then the person can be saved. Christ being the image of God shows us that it is God working through Christ who is truly saving us. All of us, who have been saved by the gospel of Christ, should let the light of Christ shine through us into this dark world, that others may hear and be saved (Matthew 5:16). Thank you Jesus!

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
